p06.label: Sheltered camp on the old trade road

evidence.quote: DM: So, after six days on the plains, on the April 23, now a month and a day after you all met in Karawa at the occasion of the hyena attacks on the town, you find yourself now about half day's journey north of Karawa, camped in a sheltered spot along the old trade road running east-west.

DM: East leading past Gomat to the chasm in the desert, to the fort where you fought your first battles and encountered cockatrices and undead. West towards Tokra, the monastery of Lakan Mystai where Kenzo spent years in training, and eventually on towards Chardon. Then hopefully in that direction, the fields of refugees who have fled from these plains and are now encamped outside of Tokra. As you've traveled south, the land has gotten dryer and dustier, more desert-like, less—more rocky, poor sandy soils, less grasslands. And by this point you are now camped in what is a sort of sheltered, shady, rocky area where, you know, one or two scrub trees grow, but the grass—you left the last grass behind two days ago, and the last extensive vegetation this afternoon. Based on your experience and your knowledge of the land, you expect that by lunch tomorrow you will be arriving in Karawa.

p07.label: Dark workshop in the mirror

evidence.quote: DM: You see that the image—the image fades to black. And then you see a brief flash of what looks like a, you know, a sort of dark workshop. You see, like, a bench with tools scattered across it. You know, there’s a forge in the background. Wherever you are is dark, whether it's underground or at night. And then there's a brief of flare of light, and you see...

DM: So you can't hear any sound, but you see what looks like shadows flickering in the, you know, in the flash of light there’s, there’s someone or something dancing and rhythmically, almost like a chant. And as, as this proceeds again, this continues for, you know, a few seconds, and then suddenly the scene cuts away, and you see lying on the bench what looks like a—so it's like something disassembled into four pieces. There’s the—you see this sort of—and it's not finished. There's like this ivory cap of the scroll, and then there's a piece of skin. You know, not sure what kind of skin, but it doesn't look animal.

DM: Human or, or dwarves or something, laid out like being cured like leather, and then a nother piece of ivory. And the two pieces of ivory are, are sort of being... There's like a rhythmic noise as they're being carved with something iron. And as, as they're being carved, there's letters being burned into the—just sort of appearing in flames out of, this piece of skin, and it begins to curl up. And then there's another flash of darkness, and the scene goes black for a moment.

DM: And then you see a hand reach—reach in wearing a black glove. Can't make out any features of dark black glove, reach and lift this thing up and then fasten on the two—the two ends and hold, hold this thing. And those, those burst again—another burst of light as something emerging, like something is sealed. Something is—some sort of—it feels like magic being done. And you can see now a—the shape in the shadow is more distinct, and it is a creature with a long, barbed tail and two horns. And it clenches its fist on this thing, and then the mirror goes black.
